en.title: Index of the First Character That Appears Only Once
en.description:
Return the index of the first character in a lowercase string that appears exactly once in the whole string, using 1-based indexing; return −1 if there is none.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains the string; 1≤n≤100000, lowercase English letters only.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; 3; -1. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: First count the frequencies of the 26 letters, then scan from left to right for the first position whose frequency is 1.
